description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order Special Commodity Levy on potatoes & other - period for 06 months from 25.08.2016
categorisation: This gazette content is an order made under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, imposing and specifying rates for a special commodity levy on potatoes. It involves regulatory matters, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements related to taxation and trade regulations, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake, it does not focus on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the implementation of existing legislation.
